environment.label: relay-disabled-trial-1-catchup
environment.environment_notes: Same dc8eaa74 image and hardware; relay=true consumer=true; no HTTP load; recover durable disabled-trial backlog before next matched trial

postgres.version: PostgreSQL 17.11 on aarch64-unknown-linux-musl, compiled by gcc (Alpine 15.2.0) 15.2.0, 64-bit

environment.load_model: closed-loop persistent HTTP, no POST retry, bounded per-worker histograms
environment.event_latency_definition: database inbox.processed_at minus outbox.created_at, exact database percentiles; includes backlog wait
environment.publication_latency_definition: database outbox.published_at minus created_at; may lag Kafka acceptance
environment.scope: user-to-user transfers between fresh fixture accounts; issuance funding excluded

event_rate_note: scoped durable count deltas over database observation times; interval includes measurement setup/inspection
